create_object_detection_evaluator: create an ObjectDetectionEvaluator with categories and matching IOU threshold for evaluating object detection results
add_groundtruth_to_evaluator: add ground truth boxes and class labels for a single image to the ObjectDetectionEvaluator
add_detections_to_evaluator: add detected boxes, scores, and class labels for a single image to the ObjectDetectionEvaluator
evaluate_detection_metrics: evaluate the ObjectDetectionEvaluator and return mAP, per-class AP, precision, recall, and CorLoc metrics
create_pascal_evaluator: create a PascalDetectionEvaluator with a matching IOU threshold for PASCAL VOC style object detection evaluation
